main_text.p: Theologicas nihil fere præter rationes metaphysicas afferant; sed longe adhuc infensiorem illis se ostendit in commentariis, quæ postea edidit, de sacris Ecclesiæ ordinationibus {r}illos enim ab operis sui exordio traducit tanquam homines imperitos & argumenti quod tractat plane ignaros. Jam illud opus, ut supra observatum fuit, Romæ inchoaverat, cum cuidam Theologorum Congregationi interesset, in qua jussu Urbani VIII,Pontificis Maximi Græcorum Euchologium ad fidei Ecclesiæ Romanæ regulam expendebatur; quid autem à se in hac materia præstitum sit, declarat in Epistola ad Leonem Allatium, cui scripsit, se inquisivisse in sacras Clericorum ordinationes tam Græcas quam Latinas. Inqui-sitionem illam, inquit, Scholastico more non instituo; id existimo hac in causa & probationibus, quas adhibeo, plane inuti-le: his enim argumentis cedat universa Scholastica, & illis se accommodet necesse est. Deinde addit, se in lucem edere an-

page.notes: The line "VIII,Ponti-" shows what may be a comma where a full stop is expected; transcribed as printed. The footnote "Parif." is read as "Paris" (long s). The catchword "tiqvis-" is set at right below the last line and is kept as printed, with its hyphen. The paragraph continues onto the next page.
